# resolve/symbol

> Rename rule: an operator symbol in the syntax of a package or truck.

truck [resolve](../resolve.md) · [source](../../../registry/resolve/symbol.pkg)

```
resolve
  rename symbol '<>' in sets to '<!>'
end
```

The symbol changes in every syntax pattern of the scope, so two packages
that both define `<>` can be used together: one of them now spells it
`<!>`. Library code and expand templates of packages that need the scope
are rewritten too. Symbols are punctuation, apart from `(`, `)`, `,`,
braces and quotes, and must not contain `//`. It is an error if no
pattern in the scope uses the symbol.
